name: Merchant of Truth
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, investigate.
Clues you control have exalted. (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each instance of exalted among permanents you control.)
blocked_sentences: Clues you control have exalted. (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each instance of exalted among permanents you control.)

needs.what: the exalted keyword (702.83): each instance on a permanent you control triggers when a creature you control attacks alone, giving that creature +1/+1 until end of turn; it must be grantable to other permanents (here Clues you control, via the grant_keyword static with affects {controller: you, subtypes: [Clue]}) and each instance counts separately
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exalted is not in the keyword list, so the grant_keyword static cannot name it. A grant_ability static handing Clues a quoted triggered ability is the near miss, but no trigger event or trigger key expresses 'a creature you control attacks alone' (attacks / you_attack have no alone/sole-attacker filter), and a granted trigger would not be an instance of exalted for other cards that count or grant it
